title: llm.validation_failed
description: An LLM output failed schema or cross-field (V1-V9) validation twice in a row. Emitted by core/llm.py::complete_json() immediately before raising LLMValidationError; nothing partial is ever written (event-catalog.md §7, docs/phase1-llm-boundary.md §4). Payload matches event-catalog.md's documented shape exactly: prompt_id, prompt_version, run_id, errors.

prompt_id.description: The prompt frontmatter's id, e.g. sales/classify_reply.

run_id.description: The agent_runs.id for the failed (status='failed') run — complete_json always writes that row before emitting this event, so a run_id is always available.

errors.description: The validation errors from the second (final) attempt — schema errors, cross-field validator errors, or both.
